reasoning: Base ratings: the Nets are -8.2 and the Bulls -9.3 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Nets 1.7 better here, total 237.
Rest, travel and availability move it 1.9 towards the Bulls.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: Bulls by 0.2, 51% to win; total 237 (80% range 213-261).
